physical_cell_independence: Separate physical characteristic-volume cells are independent conditional on their prescribed local loading histories.
within_cell_density: The full joint density p(a,s,t) is retained. It is not replaced by p(a,t)*p(s,t).
additional_internal_reduction: q4=P*q2 with a1=a2=a and s1=s2=s is a holonomic coherent-motion ansatz inside the representative, separate from physical-cell independence.
energy: Gc(q2;f)=G4(P*q2;f), including every original LJ/Bessel and explicit pair term on the constraint manifold.
temperature: Original theta=0.02 for full Gc. If Gc/2 were used instead, theta would also need to be divided by two; that convention is not used here.
intact_reference: A new stable minimum and GI(f) are computed for this constrained energy; original 4D GI numbers are not copied.
data_marginalization: Old killed-joint survivor marginals each integrate to S_joint. Their copied global F/U is not a cell-specific first-passage CDF and cannot be composed with a survival product.
physical_limit: Coherence suppresses relative escape modes and can change the initiation probability. Cell independence or equal marginal distributions alone does not establish the coherent-motion ansatz.
physical_mesh_vs_probability_grid: Physical mesh volume and Vc are separate from the numerical a/s control-volume quadrature.
physical_calibration_status: The present benchmark does not calibrate MPa, seconds, Vc, physical mobility, 30um crack initiation, or experimental S-N lifetime.
specimen_survival: S_spec=product_i S_i only for independently initialized cell processes under the specified load; the production test uses two illustrative replicas rather than a full specimen mesh.
validation_scope: Observed finite-domain spatial/refinement and numerical action validation, not a certified continuum bound or experimental fatigue validation.
